notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Indoraptor.
description:
Deal damage to Indoraptor.
Indoraptor and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Indoraptor trigger, dealing damage to an opponent unless they sacrifice a nontoken creature.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Indoraptor instead due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.
